author: ytilauxesomoh
body:
First off, I don't feel like leading anymore or trying to, I expected the win as I did back on conquest thing tournament 5 o 4 , this team started like a normal team getting players that were mainly my friends I enjoyed playing conquest and this race to victory tournament, I am glad I got to know all the members, AdamChen was teh reason of us winning that guy is a fking legend? good run with everyone on the team old and new ones.
We are disbanding because neither me nor Momlas want to lead, was a good oportunity to say good bye to everyone on avicus, I don't think I will be playing avicus more except if AdamChen creates PureBlox here, good luck to every team and have fun playing tournaments.
Subir, Ny_, Loo thanks to be in the team with me ;)
I'm doing this so everyone in TEAMLAS know why we are not doing more tournaments.

G_G
